# We Store Frozen

We Store Frozen is a Warehousing and Storage company. We Store Frozen employs 11 people (+57.1% YoY, +4 people), founded in 2024. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Brazil.

## About

We Store Frozen is a full-service, multi-temperature 3PL strategically located in Houston, Texas.

By combining frozen, refrigerated, ambient, and dry storage under one roof, we help brands consolidate their supply chain with a single logistics partner. No splitting inventory across multiple facilities. No added complexity. Just one strategic location for warehousing, fulfillment, distribution, and value-added services.

Built for growing food, beverage, and consumer brands that need every temperature—without compromising efficiency.

# Frozen Logistics | Delivered Cold

Frozen Logistics | Delivered Cold is a Internet Marketplace Platforms company. Frozen Logistics provides on-demand cold storage, refrigerated trucking, logistics management and order fulfillment in a major new Texas facility. Frozen Logistics | Delivered Cold employs 19 people, founded in 2020. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, United States, with an office in Taylor. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Albania.

## About

Frozen Logistics is the parent company of Delivered Cold, the first nationwide direct-to-consumer fulfillment marketplace built exclusively for frozen goods.

Through Delivered Cold, we provide brands with a seamless way to store, ship, and deliver frozen products directly to consumers’ doors — ensuring quality, reliability, and speed. Our platform is designed to remove the barriers of cold chain distribution, making it as simple for food brands to sell online as it is for apparel or electronics.

Why Delivered Cold?

Nationwide reach with scalable fulfillment and last-mile delivery management.

Purpose-built cold storage and logistics network.

A marketplace that connects frozen food brands directly with consumers.
